title: Miss Lady Hawk Herself
search_title_used: Mare of EasttownMiss Lady Hawk Herself
premise_summary: "Miss Lady Hawk Herself" is the series premiere of the American crime drama television miniseries Mare of Easttown. The episode was written by series creator Brad Ingelsby, and directed by executive producer Craig Zobel. It was first broadcast on HBO in the United States on April 18, 2021, and also was available on HBO Max on the same date.
